senses.gloss:
कुड् कुड्, cl. 6. P. कुडति, चुकोड, कुडितुम्,
to play or act as a child, to trifle; to eat; to
heap; to plunge under water, be immersed, dive (?).

कूड् कूड्, cl. 6. P. कूडति, -डितुम्, to eat;
to graze; to become firm or fat or solid.

कुडङ्ग कुडङ्ग, अस्, m. a bower, an arbour;
[cf. कुटङ्क, कुटुङ्गक, कुण्डङ्ग.]
कुडप कुडप, अस्, अम्, m. n. = कुडव below.

कुडव कुडव, अस्, m. a measure of grain,
wood, iron, &c., the fourth part of a Prastha, de-
scribed by some as a vessel four fingers wide and as
many deep and containing twelve Prakṛtis or hand-
fuls; it is also said to contain 13(1/2) cubic Angulas;
or to be a finger and a half deep, and three fingers
[]
each in length and breadth; in medicine it is equal
to two Prakṛtis or thirty-two Tolakas.
कुडि कुडि, इस्, m. the body; [cf. कुटि.]

कुडी कुडी, f. a small house, a hut; (a wrong
reading for कुटी?).

कुडिका कुडिका, f. an earthen or wooden
water-pot used by ascetics; [cf. कुट.]

कुडिश कुडिश, अस्, m. a kind of fish, com-
commonly Kūrchi, Cyprinus Curchius.

कुडुप कुडुप, अस्, m. the clasp or fastening
of a necklace or bracelet.

कुड्मल कुड्मल, अस्, आ, अम्, opening or ex-
panding as the blossom of a flower, blossoming; (अस्),
m. an opening bud; (अम्), n. a particular hell; some-
times also spelt कुद्मल; [cf. कुट्मल.]
—कुड्-
मल-दन्ती, f., N. of a metre, = अनुकूला; also
spelt कुद्मल-दन्ती.

कुड्मलित, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with opening
buds; budded, blossomed; cheerful, smiling (as the
countenance).

कुड्य कुड्य, अम्, आ, n. f. a wall; plaster-
ing (a wall); eagerness, curiosity.
—कुड्य-च्छेदिन्,
ई, m. a housebreaker, a thief.
—कुड्य-च्छेद्य, अम्,
n. an opening, a hole in a wall, a breach.
—कुड्य-
मत्सी, f. or कुड्य-मत्स्य, अस्, m. a house-lizard.
कूड्य कूड्य, अम्, n. a wall, = कुड्य.
